FULL TEXT:
Walk in interview for the Post of Lab. Technician
Walk-in-Interview to fill up of One (01) Post of Lab. Technician at Dr. SSBUICET, Panjab
University, Chandigarh on temporary basis at Fixed salary of Rs. 30,000/- for 11 months or
as per the availability of funds and further extendable as per the requirement, will be held on
31.08.2026 (Monday). Details are mentioned below:
Name of the Post: Lab. Technician (01)
Essential Qualification:
B.Sc./Diploma in Engg and Technology (3 years)/B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering,
Instrumentation Engineering, or any allied field.
Desirable Qualifications:
 M.Sc. in Analytical Chemistry/Industrial Chemistry/ Instrumentation
 M.E./M.Tech.
 Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting
high-end analytical equipment (GC, HPLC, FTIR, etc.) in an academic research facility or an
industrial R&D laboratory.
Role overview:
The lab technician will be responsible for the daily operation, maintenance,
calibration, and troubleshooting of sophisticated analytical and pilot-scale instruments
within the department. This role serves as the critical bridge between complex
chemical engineering hardware and the researchers, faculty, and students who rely on
them for precise data. The individual will ensure that all high-end equipment remains
in optimal working condition while enforcing strict laboratory safety and compliance
protocols.
Key Responsibilities:
 Operate and manage sophisticated analytical instruments commonly used in chemical
engineering, such as Gas Chromatographs (GC), High-Performance Liquid
Chromatographs (HPLC), FTIR Spectrometers, UV-Vis Spectrophotometers,
Rheometers, and Particle Size Analyzers.
 Perform routine preventative maintenance and standard calibration of all assigned
equipment to ensure continuous accuracy and prevent costly breakdowns.
 Coordinate directly with external vendors and original equipment manufacturers
(OEMs) for major repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), and software
upgrades.
 Maintain clear, updated logbooks, user manuals, and maintenance records for every
piece of equipment.
 Maintain the inventory of essential consumables, standard reagents, and spare parts
required for uninterrupted instrument operation.
General Conditions:
 The engagement shall be purely temporary and shall not confer any right for regular
appointment.
 The decision of the Institute shall be final in all matters.
 Prior Notice period of one month.
Venue of the Walk-in-Interview: Alumni Lounge, Dr. SSBUICET, Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
Date of walk-in-interview: 31.08.2026 (Monday)
Reporting time: 10.00 AM
The candidates are required to bring the prescribed application form which is available at
https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php , with following:
 Two photographs
 Two sets of photocopies of the certificates
 Original documents/certificate for verification.
No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending aforesaid walk-in-interview
Chairperson
Dr. S. S. Bhatnagar University Institute of Chemical Engineering & Technology (UICET)
Panjab University, Chandigarh
